completion:
Pay attention to vocabulary.
3. Agree on a format.
4. Look closely at extenuating circumstances.
5. Be wary of boilerplate.
6. Use photographs to help.
7. Summarise the relevant information.

### 1. Start with the inspection records

Following the inspection, the inspector(s) will collate the data and generate a building-standards report. The Visit record, upon which the report is based, has the check results that the inspector entered at time of inspection. These are the maximum accuracy you can expect to document. The Visit report may need revisiting before it is final at both council and private sectors.

There is sometimes consistency between Visit reports and reports PMs may see on HUD portal. There is also the potential to correct oversight or change opinion in the final version that the buyer receives. Do not ignore if there are checks and results you think are important to the checking process
